skill_name: Compare and contrast two European political systems.
workflow: France and Germany are two different countries in Europe with different political systems. In France, the government is an integrated republic with a semi-presidential system and a bicameral legislature. Meanwhile, Germany’s is based on the Basic Law of 1949, which is a constitutional democracy with a federal system and a bicameral legislature. Both countries have parliamentary systems, although Germany is more decentralized with individual states playing a more active role in policy-making. Fra
